title: decision frame: elevate startup scope discipline to a first-class fourth axis — 三轴 becomes 四维, all four synced copies at once
body:
Maintainer ruling (2026-08-18, PM chat with the skills seat, session `session_01WswfK2yNYT9hNnMH6TzAwL`), verbatim: 「9769 应该是四维度分析,但是还在写三轴。从实际业务需求,从平台长远合理性,从避免AI写代码犯错的角度,从创业阶段不扩散需求的角度。」

Today the frame declares THREE fixed axes (business need → long-term soundness → AI-authoring safety) and folds startup scope discipline inside axis 1 as 创业阶段聚焦原则, while the four-facet card block already serializes FOUR facets ("四棱是三条评估轴的卡面序列化"). The ruling makes the fourth a first-class axis: **实际业务需求 · 平台长远合理性 · 防 AI 写代码犯错 · 创业阶段不扩散需求** — axes and facets one-to-one.

## Change

- All FOUR synced copies of the decision frame, in one PR (`check:skill-frame-sync` enforces isomorphism, so partial edits cannot land): `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (评估轴 section + the 四棱 serialization sentence), `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (~line 291), and the published copy the sync gate tracks under `skills/` (locate via the gate's own file list). Extract 创业阶段不扩散 from axis 1 into axis 4 with its existing content (聚焦原则 quote, implementation-first default, sunk-cost clause — moved, not rewritten); update every count-co-varying phrase (三条/三轴/three axes → 四条/四维/four axes) — the sync checker is count-agnostic by design (its header documents that a 3→4 edit extracts and re-syncs), so the gate self-adjusts; its mutation self-tests reference axis counts and may need their fixture strings retargeted — re-run `--self-test` and adjust fixtures only if red.
- The guards-index row wording (三轴决策框架 → 四维决策框架) in SKILL.md.
- Ratchets: SKILL.md 681/682 (headroom 1), os-dev.md 352/399; the published copy is under `skills/` (governed, unratcheted). Net movement expected near zero (extraction, not addition).

Serial: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` is occupied by queued PR #9720 — **dispatch only after #9720 is MERGED**. `SKILL.md` is occupied by hanging PR #9769 — the ruling is to merge #9769 AS-IS (its 三轴 wording matches the then-current frame) and land this rename behind it; if #9769 merges first there is no conflict window.

Fable (clause ① path mandate); governed ⇒ draft, human merge.
